doc: Device-clock time of day, weather and seasons. Local time = device local clock (Time.get_datetime_dict_from_system()). Phase starts are seconds after local midnight; each phase cross-fades in over crossfade_s starting at its start time. See docs/GDD.md section 6.
g_day_wrap_note: night is 1.0 and also 0.0: g_day jumps 1.0 -> 0.0 at 00:00, which is seamless because the palette gradient has night at both ends

weather_plan.doc: Per local calendar day d, seed the plan RNG from (install_seed, d). Draw the number of rain episodes and the number of breeze episodes from the count probabilities (index = count), then for each episode a start uniformly in [0, 86400) s after local midnight and a duration uniformly in [min, max]. Episodes may run past midnight. Rain wins over breeze; otherwise clear. A drawn plan never changes.

season_note: MVP ships Spring only; season_cycle grows to [spring, summer, autumn, winter] later. Seasons never remove anything: out-of-season flowers stay planted and keep counting; out-of-season species simply rest.
